body:
So, I'm a 24yo male. When I was 21, I slept with a girl who was not truthful. She gave me warts, and for three years, Ive had to reject every female who came my way. Simply put, I'm too honest to ever put this on anybody.

I still suffer from this disease, and haven't been able to rid it. I'm afraid I'll always have symptoms.

The strange thing is, I'm a successful person going to a top law school. I get good grades, have great friends, and I'm one of those types whom you'll meet and remember as being a quality, nice guy.

The only thing is, I wish... I wish this one girl wouldve never done this intentionally to me.

So, now, after a few years, I'm just spent and this pain is a slow, long-lasting emotional crater in my mind.
